claim: A voucher code of fewer than 8 characters can end up stored in the vault.
why: Vault.add strips the code and refuses anything under 8 characters. The bulk loader measures each raw line before stripping, so a 7-character code followed by a newline counts as 8 and is stored as 7 characters. The README says the loader applies the same rule, which is the trap.

deciding.note: loader counts the newline so a 7-character code passes

root.claim: A code shorter than 8 characters can be stored

atoms.claim: Vault.add accepts a code shorter than 8 characters
atoms.evidence: add strips the code then raises ValueError when len < MIN_LEN.

atoms.claim: The bulk loader stores a 7-character code
atoms.evidence: load checks len(line) before rstrip, so a 7-character code followed by a newline has length 8 and is stored as 7 characters; feeding the loader 'ABCDEFG\n' stores ABCDEFG.
